verdict.rationale: Asana's developer platform has a dedicated webhooks guide stating that webhooks let an application be notified of changes in Asana, and the platform overview lists webhooks as a first-party feature alongside the API. This is the product's own outbound callback mechanism for event subscription. Missing for 10: documented details of webhook registration (create/filter endpoints), delivery and handshake/security mechanics, event-type coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
